aiSuggestionsHelp: Inline ghost-text completion. Manual: press ⌘L to invoke. Tab accepts, Esc dismisses.
editorWidthHelp: How wide the writing column is. Narrow improves focus; wide is better for tables and code.
editorBgHelp: Override the writing pane color. Leave as Default to follow the theme.
llmBannerSuffix: to unlock inline AI completion, quick commands and automatic tags.
deleteFolderConfirm: Delete folder "{name}"? Everything in it moves up one level.
deleteNoteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It will be moved to the Trash.
noNotesYet: No notes yet — press ⌘N to create one
welcomeSubtitleEmpty: Create your first note to get started.

noteReloadedFromDisk: Updated from another source and reloaded.

linkUpdateModeHelp: When a note is renamed or moved, rewrite the [[links]] that point to it in other notes. Each changed note keeps a history snapshot, so it can be undone.
linkUpdateConfirm: Update the links to "{name}"? {links} link(s) in {notes} note(s) will be changed.
linkUpdatePartial: Could not update links in {n} note(s).
attachmentsFolderHelp: Pasted and dropped images are saved here (inside the vault), named by their content, and notes keep only the path.
attachmentsFolderInvalid: Use a plain folder name: letters, numbers, spaces, - and _.
embeddedMove: Move embedded images out of notes…
embeddedHelp: Older versions stored images inside the note text. This moves them to the images folder; each changed note keeps a history snapshot.
embeddedConfirm: Move {images} embedded image(s) ({distinct} different, {size} MB) out of {notes} note(s) into "{folder}"? Each changed note keeps a history snapshot, so this can be undone.
orphanAttachmentsConfirm: Also delete the {n} image(s) that only this note used? They go to the system Trash.
gitSyncHelp: Commits your changes, then pulls from and pushes to this branch's upstream. It never force-pushes, and it pauses if the same note changed on both sides.
gitSyncStatusConflict: Sync paused: notes changed on both sides ({n})
gitSyncStatusUnconfigured: No upstream branch to sync with
gitSyncConflictToast: Sync paused: some notes changed on both sides ({n}). Open Git to resolve them.
conflictIntro: These notes changed here and on the remote. Nothing has been overwritten. Choose what to keep for each one.
conflictKindDeletedByUs: Deleted here, changed on the remote
conflictKindDeletedByThem: Changed here, deleted on the remote
conflictBinary: This file can't be shown as text. Choose which version to keep.
noModelsHelp: Start LM Studio / Ollama and click "Detect models"
defaultModelHelp: Leave empty to use the default model
lmStudioHelp: The local URL where LM Studio is running.
apiKeyHelp: Your key is encrypted with the OS keychain.
llmProviderHelp: Generation model used for chat, commands, and AI actions.
aiHowItWorksBody: Noted uses one generation model (the provider/model above) for writing/chat tasks. Retrieval is local and runs on your notes before each AI answer.
aiRetrievalMode: Retrieval: local keyword (TF-IDF), upgraded to hybrid keyword + semantic when embeddings are enabled below.
mcpSectionBody: Use this only if you want another MCP-compatible app/agent to read/write your notes through Noted tools.
mcpSectionNotRequired: The in-app AI does not require MCP: it works directly with your current provider settings.
mcpTabBody: Connect external AI tools (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Codex CLI, …) to your Noted vault. They will be able to list, read, search, create, update and delete notes through six MCP tools.
mcpHowItWorks: The MCP server is a small stdio program your client spawns on demand. Noted itself does not run it — you just point your client at the file below.
mcpStatusMissing: Server not built yet — run the build command below
mcpClientVsCodeHint: Add to .vscode/mcp.json in your workspace (or User Settings → MCP)
mcpAfterAdding: Restart the client after editing its config. Then ask it: "list my Noted notes".
mcpSseToggleHelp: Expose the MCP server over HTTP/SSE. This allows remote clients (like Claude iOS on your phone) to connect to Noted.
mcpTrashRetentionHelp: When an AI assistant deletes a note over MCP it goes to the vault's .noted/trash and can be restored. 0 keeps it until you remove it by hand.
mcpSsePortHelp: The port the local HTTP server will listen on.
mcpSseAuthHeader: Auth header (add to your MCP client)
mcpSseAuthHeaderHelp: The SSE server requires this token on every request. Send it as the X-MCP-Token header.
mcpSseCloudflareHelp: To connect a remote device securely, run a Cloudflare Tunnel:
ragSectionBody: Tune how much note context is retrieved and sent to the model.
ragDebugDesc: Show retrieval scores (lexical/dense/combined) in AI chat.
embeddingsBetaDesc: Hybrid retrieval — blends keyword search with semantic similarity to pick the notes sent to the AI chat. Off by default.
embeddingsBetaNote: When enabled with a provider and embedding model, related notes are ranked by meaning (semantic) blended with keywords. Falls back to keyword-only if the model is unavailable.
smartTagsDesc: Automatically suggest tags for notes in the background using AI.
piiMaskingDesc: Automatically mask emails, phone numbers, credit cards and IDs before sending to AI.
analyticsNoContent: Open a note to see analytics
cloudSyncDesc: Notes are stored in the selected folder and synced automatically by the provider.
shortcutQuickOpen: Quick open — search and open note
shortcutFocusMode: Focus mode (dims everything except current paragraph)
cmdContinueDesc: Continue writing from the current point
cmdExpandDesc: Elaborate and deepen the current paragraph
cmdSummarizeDesc: Synthesize the note into key points
cmdImproveDesc: Improve clarity and style of the text
cmdTranslateDesc: Translate to English (or Italian if already in English)
aiGreeting: Hello! I'm your assistant. I can read what you write and help you. How can I help you today?
aiError: Error: {msg}. Check settings (Provider and API Key).
contextTruncated: Note exceeds context limit (8,000 chars) — only the first portion was sent to the AI.
noVersions: No saved versions. Versions are created automatically on each save.
gitNoRemote: Set a remote URL in Settings to create a PR.
gitNoToken: GitHub token required. Add it in the Git settings.
gitTokenHelp: Token stored encrypted. Requires repo scope.
gitEnableDesc: Track note changes with version control
importObsidianDesc: Import notes, images, and attachments. Keeps Wikilinks and flattens nested directories.
importAppleNotesDesc: Import all your notes from macOS Apple Notes. Converts HTML to Markdown and preserves creation/modification dates.
dangerZoneDesc: Permanently delete all notes, folders, and templates from disk. This action cannot be undone.
wipeAllNotesConfirm: Are you absolutely sure you want to delete ALL notes and folders? This cannot be undone.

agentNoTasks: No tasks in this workflow metadata.

errLlmTimeoutFriendly: Timeout: the AI provider did not respond in time.

gitDisabledInfo: Git integration lets you version-control your notes, create branches, push to GitHub, open PRs, and save notes as public or private Gists — all from inside Noted.
importSubtitle: Import notes from other local sources.
errBoundaryBody: An unexpected error occurred. Reloading usually fixes it — your notes are safe on disk.
globalSearchPlaceholder: Search in all notes… (content, not just filenames)
globalSearchHint: Full-text search · type at least 2 characters
errNoAgentMetadata: This note has no Agent Metadata block.
searchTruncated: Showing the top matches — refine your search to narrow it down.
noteFormatHelpHtml: Notes are stored as HTML inside .md files. Converting them to Markdown makes every note a plain text file that other apps (Obsidian, VS Code, Git diffs) can read and edit.
noteFormatHelpMarkdown: Notes are stored as Markdown: plain text files that any other app can open. You can go back to HTML at any time.
noteFormatReportIntro: Nothing has been changed yet. A zip copy of every note is made first, and each note keeps its old text in its history, so this can be undone.
noteFormatRaw: {n} keep some parts as raw HTML (shown as code in the editor)
noteFormatFormatting: {n} lose some formatting (colours, fonts, merged cells)
noteFormatBlocked: Nothing can be converted until the notes that failed are fixed or removed. Nothing was changed.
noteFormatLossyAck: Convert anyway. I accept that these notes lose text; the backup keeps the originals.
noteFormatDone: Converted {n} note(s). The backup is in {path}.
noteFormatFailedRun: Could not check the notes. Nothing was changed.
gitViewDiff: Compare with the last saved version
gitStageError: Could not change what is staged
gitDiffNoChanges: No visible change in the text. Only formatting differs.

mcpAccessHelp: Choose what assistants connected through MCP can reach. Hidden folders do not exist for them: not listed, not read, not searched, not written. The most specific folder wins. Changes apply to the next request.
mcpAccessInvalid: The policy file is invalid: {error}. Assistants can reach nothing until it is fixed.
